units.source_text: “因为曾经跪拜在对方面前的屈辱回忆，将使你把脚踏在他的头上。

en.t: The humiliating memory of once kneeling before the other person will make you plant your foot on his head.

units.source_text: 我是为了不受将来的屈辱，才拒绝现在别人的尊敬的。

en.t: I refuse other people’s respect now so that I will not suffer humiliation in the future.

units.source_text: 我宁愿忍受现在的孤独，也不愿忍受将来更深的孤独。

en.t: I would rather endure my loneliness now than endure a deeper loneliness in the future.

units.source_text: 我们生在充满自由、独立和自我的现代社会，就必须付出品尝这种孤独的代价。”

en.t: Born into a modern society filled with freedom, independence, and selfhood, we must pay the price of tasting this loneliness.

units.source_text: 对于抱有这种想法的先生，我不知该说什么好。

en.t: Faced with Sensei holding such thoughts, I did not know what I ought to say.
